context: Tests whether the agent produces a SKILL.md with correct frontmatter, a description that activates on natural user language (both actions and situations, no workflow leakage), and a Boundaries section that clearly scopes the skill.

checklist.name: No version in frontmatter
checklist.description: The SKILL.md frontmatter does NOT contain a 'version' field — only 'name' and 'description' are present

checklist.name: Description includes actions
checklist.description: The description field includes at least one phrase describing what a user actively asks to do (e.g., 'generate changelog', 'summarize commits', 'prepare release notes', or equivalent action-oriented language)

checklist.name: Description includes situations
checklist.description: The description field includes at least one phrase describing a situation the user is experiencing (e.g., 'wants to', 'is preparing', 'needs to', 'asks about', or equivalent situation-oriented language)

checklist.name: No workflow in description
checklist.description: The description field does NOT contain steps, numbered lists, or workflow implementation details (e.g., no 'parses commits', 'filters by prefix', 'groups into categories' style language in the description)

checklist.name: Boundaries section present
checklist.description: SKILL.md contains a section explicitly named 'Boundaries' (or equivalent heading) that states what the skill DOES

checklist.name: Boundaries lists Does NOT
checklist.description: The Boundaries section explicitly states at least one thing the skill Does NOT do

checklist.name: Body does not restate description triggers
checklist.description: The skill body does NOT contain a 'When to use' section or equivalent that duplicates the activation criteria already in the description

checklist.name: Name is lowercase-hyphenated
checklist.description: The 'name' field in frontmatter uses lowercase hyphenated format (e.g., 'generate-changelog' or similar) — no spaces, no uppercase

checklist.name: Skill directory structure
checklist.description: Output is placed inside a named skill directory (e.g., changelog-skill/ or similar) rather than loose files

checklist.name: design-notes.md present
checklist.description: A design-notes.md file exists in the working directory (outside the skill folder) containing at least the skill name and trigger phrase rationale
